path.data-text: Light, then chime, then voice, and only when you are near. Time, air and the next alarm are always visible.
Dose time: ring glows softly, tiles turn black
If you are near: one soft chime
Still not opened: voice line, screen inverts
Open a compartment: its tile shows the time
All opened: ring off, next alarm shown
All day: what was opened, and when
